summary: Frontend-only verification of the in-app notification bell (iteration 5). All 7 scenarios from the review request pass. Client (pwuser@example.com) logs in, sees the bell in the top-right (data-testid=notif-bell) with no badge when empty. Creating a booking on Mon 2026-07-20 07:00 with Sarah Johnson via the /booking UI (confirm-booking-btn) surfaces both a stored 'Session booked' notification and an 'Upcoming session' reminder (booking is within 48h). After a fresh reload the bell shows a red badge (data-testid=notif-badge) with count '2' (1 unread notif + 1 reminder). Clicking the bell opens the panel (data-testid=notif-panel) listing exactly 2 items (data-testid=notif-item): the reminder ('Upcoming session — With Sarah Johnson — in 17h 29m (2026-07-20 at 07:00)') with a CalendarClock + Video icon, and 'Session booked — With Sarah Johnson on 2026-07-20 at 07:00.'. Opening the bell POSTs /api/notifications/read; a reload confirms unread dropped 1→0 while the reminder persists, so the badge falls from 2 to 1 (reminder-only). Re-opening the panel still shows both items. Clicking the 'Upcoming session' item navigates the client to /call/6179d64d-... (video call page). Regression: admin@fitcoach.com login lands on /admin with the bell rendering + panel opening cleanly (badge=0). sarah.trainer@fitcoach.com login lands on /trainer with the bell rendering, badge=1 (Pat Lee's Mon 07:00 booking counts as her upcoming reminder), and panel opening cleanly. No JS errors on any shell (the ERR_UNKNOWN_URL_SCHEME lines on /call are pre-existing Jitsi mobile-deep-link warnings, and the two 401s on logout are the /notifications poll firing between clearing the cookie and unmounting — harmless race).

issues: Bell sits alone flush right above the page title with 10px bottom margin. On short pages it looks a bit floaty. Non-blocking; consider absolute-positioning it inside the header or aligning with the greeting row on the dashboard.

critical_code_review_comments: NotificationBell.js polls /api/notifications every 60s but the polling continues even after logout — that produces the two 401 console errors observed at logout. Since AuthContext already knows the auth state, gating the poll (or clearInterval on 401) would be cleaner.

toggle() awaits POST /notifications/read then reload()s the list — good. But if the user closes the panel super fast (before the POST returns), a stale unread count could briefly repaint. Minor; not a functional bug.

list_notifications() computes reminders from ALL bookings for user_id OR trainer_id (client + trainer bookings share the same code path) — good. The 48h window uses timedelta(minutes=-30) to keep the reminder for 30 min past start so a user landing late can still click 'Join'. Nice touch.

push_notification is fired on booking create for BOTH client and trainer (server.py L501/503) — verified: Sarah's badge shows 1 (upcoming reminder) after pwuser booked her; if she reloads within 60s she'd also see a stored 'New booking' notif. This works but the count of 1 in her badge came only from the reminder because in the polled state the stored notif count was already read from a prior test; on a fresh trainer account both would count.

server.py is now 1024 lines (was 960 in iteration 4, 762 in iteration 3). Continues to grow; the split-into-routers recommendation from iteration 4 still stands and the newly added /notifications endpoints are a good extraction seed.

seed_data_creation: One booking was created via the UI as part of the test flow (pwuser + Sarah Johnson, 2026-07-20 07:00, booking id 6179d64d-b5e0-4cf2-8026-6e63164e13c1) and NOT cancelled — it is needed for future retests to keep an active reminder within 48h. The associated 'Session booked' notification for pwuser is now marked read; the reminder auto-expires when the session date passes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The bell UI is fully wired: GET /api/notifications returns {notifications, reminders, unread, badge}; POST /api/notifications/read flips unread to 0 (reminders unaffected). Poll interval is 60s so if you need an immediate badge after a state change, reload the page instead of waiting. To simulate 'reminder gone', either delete the booking (bin icon on the booking card) or push its date beyond +48h; to simulate 'unread again', create a new booking or promote a role via admin. To re-run this suite: login as pwuser, book a weekday session within 48h (Mon-Fri, times 07/08/09/17/18/19), verify badge >=2, open bell, verify list, reload, verify unread dropped, click reminder → /call/<id>. Trainers cover Mon-Fri only, so if 'today' is Friday+ you'll need date >= next Monday (which pushes past 48h and drops the reminder count).
